name: NomadCounsel — Lead Triage & Attorney Approval System

parameters.content:
## NomadCounsel — Lead Triage & Attorney Approval System

**Purpose:** Automates intake, risk classification, partner approval, and routing of Digital Nomad visa applicants for high-net-worth individuals.

**Workflow Paths:**
1. 🔴 **High Risk** → Partner Approval Loop → Approve (Master Leads) or Reject (Rejection Email)
2. 🟢 **Standard** → Direct to Paralegal Queue Sheet
3. ⚠️ **Error** → Admin Alert via Slack + Email

**Triage Criteria (ANY = High Risk):**
- Investment amount ≥ $500,000
- Previous visa denials ≥ 1
- Nationality from a designated high-risk country list

**Key Design Notes:**
- Webhook responds immediately after Normalize (HTTP closes, workflow continues async)
- After Wait resumes, lead data is recovered via $('Set — Tag as High Risk').item.json
- All Set nodes use mode:raw with Object.assign for clean JSON mapping

**Last Updated:** 2026-04-17  |  **Version:** 2.0.0
**Owner:** NomadCounsel Operations

### 📥 STAGE 1: INTAKE & TRIAGE
Webhook → Normalize → **Respond immediately** → Triage IF

HTTP connection closes right after Normalize so the intake form gets
a fast ACK with a reference number. All downstream work runs async.

**Test Pins available (5 cases):**
• Case 1 — High Risk: Russia $750K 1 denial
• Case 2 — High Risk: China $1.2M (investment only)
• Case 3 — High Risk: Venezuela $80K (nationality only)
• Case 4 — Standard: UK $85K clean
• Case 5 — Standard: Brazil $120K clean

### 🟢 STAGE 2: STANDARD — PARALEGAL QUEUE
Bypasses partner approval entirely.
Lead is tagged, written to Paralegal Queue sheet, and Slack notifies the paralegal team.

### ⚠️ CATCH-ALL ERROR HANDLER
Fires on any unhandled workflow error.
Sends alert to Slack #workflow-errors AND admin email
with execution ID, failed node name, and error message.

nodes.name: Webhook — Intake Form
nodes.notes:
Public intake endpoint. responseMode=responseNode so Respond to Webhook controls the reply.
Test with pinned data: select any of the 5 pinned cases to trigger High Risk or Standard paths.

parameters.jsonOutput:
={{ {
  "leadId": $json.body.leadId || ('NC-' + $now.toFormat('yyyyMMdd') + '-' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 9000 + 1000).toString()),
  "submittedAt": $json.body.submittedAt || $now.toISO(),
  "fullName": ($json.body.fullName || $json.body.name || 'Unknown').trim(),
  "email": ($json.body.email || '').toLowerCase().trim(),
  "phone": $json.body.phone || 'Not provided',
  "nationality": ($json.body.nationality || '').trim(),
  "investmentAmount": Number($json.body.investmentAmount) || 0,
  "previousDenials": Number($json.body.previousDenials) || 0,
  "visaType": $json.body.visaType || 'Digital Nomad Visa',
  "targetCountry": ($json.body.targetCountry || '').trim(),
  "notes": $json.body.notes || '',
  "sourceIP": $json.headers['x-forwarded-for'] || $json.headers['x-real-ip'] || 'unknown'
} }}

nodes.name: Set — Normalize Lead Data
nodes.notes: JSON raw mode. Extracts all fields from $json.body (webhook payload), generates a unique leadId, timestamps the submission, and normalises strings. Output is a clean flat object — no nested body/headers.

nodes.name: Respond to Webhook
nodes.notes: Closes the HTTP connection immediately and returns a 200 JSON ACK with the leadId. Placed BEFORE triage so the form submitter always gets a fast response regardless of which path executes downstream.

nodes.name: IF — High Risk Triage
nodes.notes:
HIGH RISK if ANY condition is true:
  • Investment ≥ $500,000
  • Previous visa denials ≥ 1
  • Nationality in restricted country list

Output TRUE  (index 0) → High Risk path
Output FALSE (index 1) → Standard path

nodes.name: Set — Tag as High Risk
nodes.notes:
Spreads all normalized lead fields then appends riskLevel, computed riskReasons string, and initial status.
IMPORTANT: This node's output is referenced AFTER the Wait resumes using $('Set — Tag as High Risk').item.json to recover the lead data.

nodes.name: Slack — Partner Approval Request
nodes.notes: Sends Block Kit message to #partner-approvals. Approve/Reject button URLs embed the n8n resume token + leadId as query params. Clicking a button resumes the Wait node.

nodes.name: Wait — Await Partner Decision
nodes.notes:
Execution pauses here indefinitely until a partner clicks Approve or Reject in Slack.
When resumed, $json = { query: { decision, leadId }, body: {}, headers: {} }.
Original lead data is recovered downstream via $('Set — Tag as High Risk').item.json.

nodes.name: Set — Extract Partner Decision
nodes.notes:
KEY NODE: After Wait resumes, $json only has the resume webhook payload (query/body/headers).
This node recovers the full original lead record from $('Set — Tag as High Risk').item.json
and merges it with the partner decision + timestamp.
All downstream nodes receive the complete lead object again.

nodes.name: IF — Partner Decision
nodes.notes:
Checks normalized partnerDecision field (lowercased + trimmed by Extract node).
typeValidation: loose + caseSensitive: false so 'Approved', 'APPROVED', ' approved ' all pass.
TRUE  (approved) → Master Leads path
FALSE (rejected / unknown) → Rejection Email path

nodes.name: Set — Format Master Leads Record
nodes.notes: Merges approval metadata onto the full lead record before writing to Master Leads sheet.

nodes.name: Google Sheets — Append Master Leads
nodes.notes: Appends the approved High Risk lead to the Master Leads tab. All 17 columns mapped dynamically from $json.

nodes.name: Set — Format Rejection Record
nodes.notes: Merges rejection metadata onto the full lead record before sending email and logging.

nodes.name: Email — Professional Rejection to Lead
nodes.notes: HTML rejection email to the applicant. Subject and body are fully dynamic via $json fields. Does NOT disclose specific risk flags — references only the application ref and review outcome.

nodes.name: Google Sheets — Log Rejection
nodes.notes: Logs all partner-rejected leads for compliance audit trail. All columns mapped dynamically.

nodes.name: Set — Tag as Standard Risk
nodes.notes: Spreads all normalized lead fields, tags as Standard, and adds routing metadata. No partner approval required.

nodes.name: Google Sheets — Append Paralegal Queue
nodes.notes: Appends Standard leads to the Paralegal Queue sheet. All 15 columns mapped dynamically from $json.

elements.text: Routed at ={{ $json.routedAt }} | Risk Level: Standard | NomadCounsel Automated Intake

nodes.name: Error Trigger — Catch All
nodes.notes: Fires automatically on any unhandled error in the workflow. $json contains workflow name, execution ID, last node executed, and error message.

nodes.name: Set — Format Error Details
nodes.notes: Extracts error context from the error trigger payload into a clean flat object for Slack and email templates.

elements.text: Mode: ={{ $json.executionMode }} | Check n8n execution logs for full stack trace.

parameters.content:
### 🔴 STAGE 2: HIGH RISK — PARTNER APPROVAL LOOP
Slack Block Kit message → Wait (execution paused) → Resume via URL click

**Critical:** After Wait resumes, $json contains ONLY the resume webhook
payload (query/body/headers). Original lead data is recovered with:
`$('Set — Tag as High Risk').item.json`

Approve URL: `resumeUrl?decision=approved&leadId=...`
Reject URL:  `resumeUrl?decision=rejected&leadId=...`
